preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: 1 <= m <= n <= 3000
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of villages m is less than or equal to the number of nesting places n, both between 1 and 3000.
Number of bees in each nesting place is between 0 and 10^9.
Number of wasps in each nesting place is between 0 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: the pairs (x_i, y_i) form a tree
preconditions.description: The adjacency pairs form a tree structure with no cycles and exactly n-1 edges.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: return_value is an integer
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is an integer.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: 0 <= return_value <= m
postconditions.description: The output integer is between 0 and the number of villages m.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: return_value is the maximum number of villages where Ugly Wasp wins
postconditions.description: The output integer represents the maximum number of villages in which Ugly Wasp receives more votes than Pretty Bee.
